profile.headline: Senior Software Developer at Workday
profile.summary:
My main interest lies in the QA automation/SEO/Linguistic Analysis on Data/Log Analysis/Release Engineering.  I love finding new solutions and designing frameworks that would automate that would otherwise take whole team effort to manually accomplish the same goal.  I believe through the advancement of technology, one can utilize to push the computers to their full potentials, having them grow in intelligence, and eliminate human manual chores.  Teaching the machines to handle such fields is lots of fun, and I believe the entire humanity can benefit from this, as software technology now has blown into entire world accountable for more than just English-speaking world.

Specialties: * QA automation
* Natural Language Processing
* Release engineering/source management
* Internationalization
* SEO

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
* Develops the entire pipleline involved for smooth CI (Continuous Integration) / CD (Continuous Delivery) for mobile projects (iOS/Android) at Worday.
* Develop/maintain/refactor codes necessary to enable technologies involved in the DevOps infrastructure, including:
  * VMWare VSphere VMS/Hypervisors
  * Dockers/Kubernetes
  * Jenkins 2 Pipeline as Code
  * Automated provisioning/fault tolerance of VMs to both vertically as well as horizontally scale
* Maintains multitudes of automated tasks that goes through entire pipeline from builds to releases, from pull requests to canaries to staging/betas to app store/play store.

positions.title: Tech Educator teaching programming to children through robotics and IoT
positions.description:
* Teach programming using robotics and IoT
  * Block programming: Scratch, Blockly, Snap!, etc.
  * Arduino-based IoT/robots and drones.
* Hands-on lab-oriented courses offered.
* Develop curriculums and course materials.

positions.title: Technical Consultant and Educator
positions.description:
* Developing/Curating appropriate technology beneficial in places in Africa, Middle East, etc.
* Developing computer/IT materials/course works educating children in the countries in need.
* Promoting to aid/volunteer in NGO and participate in relief works in the local communities

positions.title: Goods Customer Experiences - QA Manager for Web/Touch and Mobile
positions.description:
* Manage 7 manual and automation SDETs for both Web/Touch and Mobile (iOS/Android) app teams across multiple timezones.
  * Leads and oversees technologies involved - 
    * Web/Touch - Java/Groovy/Kotlin, TestNG, Maven, Selenium/WebDriver, Jenkins, cURL
    * Android - Java, Espresso, JUnit
    * iOS - XCode, Swift
* Oversees QA operations in the US and abroad for Goods Customer Experience team.

positions.title: Goods Customer Experience - SDET Lead
positions.description:
* Fully expanded Functional Automated Test Framework written in Java/TestNG/Maven/Selenium-WebDriver for Goods Customer Experience team
  * Covering all Groupon-supported locales (40+)
  * Covering all supported browser types: Headless (PhantomJS/Headless Chrome), Chrome, Firefox, Safari, IE, Edge, mobile devices and tablets (iOS/Android)
  * Tightly integrated with Jenkins, Roller (in-house VM management similar to Docker), and TestRail (test case management toolkit)
* Lead 1 manual QA and 1 automation QA involving 5 independent applications with multiple sign-offs and release schedules per week cycle.
* Coverage expanded to desktop (web), mobile web (touch), as well as API validations.

positions.title: Computational Marketing / SEO - Senior SDET
positions.description:
* Architected UI and API endpoint Test Automation Framework in Ruby/rSpec/Selenium-WebDriver/cUrl
  * Covered 40+ locales
  * Supporting various browsers - phantomJS, Headless Chrome, Chrome, Firefox, IE, Edge, Safari, as well as myriads of mobile devices and tablets. 
* Achieved 100% rate of test automation in the regression suite
* Achieved autonomous build validation system using Jenkins, Github/Webhook, the test framework, and docker.
* Owned all QA and Release Engineering processes covering 6+ SOA micro-services.

positions.title: Senior QA Engineer
positions.description:
* Architected Specification by Example Acceptance Test Framework using rSpec/Cucumber with Watir/Webdriver/Mechanize from scratch (> 1M test cases)
* Using CI tools such as Hudson/Jenkins, integrated the whole build/release environment with a single click deployment
* Built release readiness validation  that approves SEO aspects of the system in an automated fashion
* Integrated Amazon Mechanical Turk system with the in-house data verification tool with scripting to ease the crowd sourcing grading to be validated for the DB use

positions.title: Technical Yahoo
positions.description:
QA automation/Release Engineering
* Quality-assure and QA automate on natural language processing technology.
* Designed and fully implemented from scratch the QA automation framework, with added test suites covering 100+ languages and associated scripts/encoding.
* Quality-assuring the natural language processing technology used by core Yahoo technologies including Yahoo! search, Yahoo! mail, Yahoo! vertical searches (including Yahoo! sponsored search), etc.

positions.title: Internationalization Engineer
positions.description:
Internationalization Engineer
* Involved in the design, qa, release, patch, source control process on all of the Actuate product lines.
* Handled I18N-related QA testing/automation, L10N-related issues handling fully-supported CCJKA combinations.
* Supported production behavior assurance on 65+ locales/encodings.

educations.fieldOfStudy: BA, Computer Science, Linguistics, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Natural Language Processing, AI
